The imagery of a bird carrying new life in its wings or nest serves as a reminder of the potential for growth and prosperity that each new generation holds. This name is a celebration of the beauty and abundance that nature brings forth.

It reminds us of the divine wisdom in creation and the responsibility we have towards preserving and nurturing the world. The name also embodies the concept of "tawakkul" or trust in Allah, as we acknowledge that He is the giver of life and sustenance. The significance of the name extends beyond the physical realm, serving as a reminder of the spiritual journey of self-growth and transformation that every individual embarks upon.
